# diagnostics

Build a redacted support bundle (version, config, logs, probes) as a zip

```text
usage: openprogram diagnostics [-h] [--output PATH]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--output` `PATH` | Write the zip here (default: ./openprogram-diagnostics-&lt;date&gt;.zip) |
